fields.name: Tutorial Loop
fields.description: A closed rectangular circuit. Spawn at the south, run the straights, sweep four corners, and cross the finish line back at the start.

fields.name: Sprint Drag
fields.description: Open-ended drag strip with a ramp up to a short plateau and a ramp back down. Great springboard to drop boost pads and decor on.

fields.name: Crossroads Circuit
fields.description: A compact 3Ã—3 loop wrapped around a 4-way crossroads. Spawn on the west straight, finish on the east â€” perfect for adding side branches.

fields.name: S-Curve Sprint
fields.description: A closed S-shaped loop that snakes left then right. Perfect for practicing smooth cornering and clean racing lines through back-to-back curves.

fields.name: Oval Track
fields.description: A smooth symmetric oval circuit perfect for high-speed racing. Two long straights connected by sweeping corners at each end.

fields.name: Figure Eight
fields.description: Two connected rectangular loops sharing a crossroads in the center. On each lap the car crosses the intersection twice, creating a true figure-eight circuit.

fields.name: Mountain Pass
fields.description: A closed loop that climbs a plateau and descends back. Straight approach, ramp up, plateau corner, ramp down, and a sweeping return straight â€” momentum management is key.

fields.name: Horseshoe
fields.description: A wide horseshoe-shaped circuit with long parallel straights connected by a tight U-turn hairpin. Great for overtaking on the straights and defending on the hairpin.

fields.name: Stadium Circuit
fields.description: A technical multi-corner stadium circuit. Short straights, frequent direction changes, and multiple chicane-style sections reward precise line choice every lap.
